decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains a specialist line that fits our rugged application-specific strengths, and with long procurement and qualification cycles the option value of staying in the market is still high.
This general interior luminaire sits in our core offering, and its continued presence suggests enough market acceptance to justify retaining it while we keep learning and refining the range.
As a flagship product aligned with our strategic move toward advanced, high-quality lighting solutions, we would keep it unless results became clearly disappointing.

After two years, the marine HMI searchlight looks like a narrow and less future-aligned option, so the information gained now favors reallocating resources to stronger and more strategic lighting platforms.

Marine searchlights still match our specialist lighting capabilities and demanding customer base, so we would continue the line while its niche commercial potential remains positive but not fully exhausted.
